definition.return: Ret_month, distinct from the Ret_20d classification target
definition.rebalance: One formation date per calendar month, monthend-to-next-monthend holding returns
definition.universe: Input-eligible historical complete cases with finite Ret_month >= -1 and finite absolute MarketCap > 0; missing-return exclusion audited
definition.selection_caveat: Complete-case filtering follows the reference code's historical comparison convention and can introduce return-availability selection bias; not a frictionless implementable-strategy guarantee
definition.sort: Ten within-date percentile groups; first group includes its lower bound, subsequent groups exclude their lower bound and include upper bound
definition.ties: If any group is empty or 10th/90th percentiles coincide, omit the date and audit it; do not invent zero returns
definition.spread: High minus Low, 100% long and 100% short
definition.annualized_return: 12 times mean observed monthly return; arithmetic, not CAGR
definition.annualized_volatility: sqrt(12) times sample monthly standard deviation, ddof=1
definition.sharpe: sqrt(12) times monthly mean divided by sample standard deviation; zero risk-free assumption
definition.costs: Gross: no transaction costs, borrow fees or financing adjustment
definition.missing_months: Report explicitly; do not fill zero; no cumulative wealth plot across internal gaps
